first_lines: # The US macro news that moves the Nasdaq: FOMC statements, CPI, the jobs report (NFP) and
# the PCE price index (Personal Income and Outlays) since 2024; from late 2026, producer prices
# (PPI), retail sales (RETAIL, Census's advance report), the GDP's advance estimate (GDP) and job
# openings (JOLTS). Times are New York's. Every date was read from the source named on its row:
# the first four kinds on 2026-10-20 (PCE's 2027 dates on 2026-10-26), the others on 2026-10-26.
# The releases of October 2025 that the shutdown cancelled are absent, the delayed ones are at the
# day they came out; dates after the day they were read are those scheduled then. BLS had not given
# the 2027 dates of JOLTS on 2026-10-26. ISM's manufacturing index is not kept: only its rule is
# public (the first business day, 10:00), which it broke in January 2026, and its dated calendar is
# for its members. Keep it up to date: python -m lab calendar check.
